title: Tutor reply output v1
description: Structured output of the tutor for one learner chat message. Recorded as an assistant.message_generated v1 payload: 'text' and 'references' are copied verbatim; the harness adds message_id, thread_id, in_reply_to, mode and provenance. 'mode' (e.g. hint, explain) is decided by the harness before the call, from the learner's optional requested_mode and the request context, and is not chosen by the model, so hint mode during an unfinished mission (AC-E3) cannot be escaped by the output. The reference solution must never appear in a reply in hint mode; a schema cannot enforce content, so this is guaranteed by keeping the reference solution out of the tutor context (AC-J6, ADR-0014). Harness-side check: every referenced id must be a highlight or event that was given to the model in this call.

references.description: Highlights and events the reply cites; rendered as visible citations. Same shape as assistant.message_generated v1 references, written with anyOf (branches are disjoint by 'type').
